newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Dec department store sales down 2.7% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Dec department store sales down 2.7% yr/yr.

text.p: Sales at department stores in Tokyo fell 2.7 percent in December from a year earlier to 298.7 billion yen, the Japan Department Stores' Association said on Thursday.
The fall in December marked the second straight month of year-on-year declines, the industry group said in a statement.
In the full 1996 calendar year, Tokyo department store sales were up 1.3 percent from the previous year to 2.43 trillion yen.
The fall in December was mainly due to sluggish sales of winter clothing because of unusually high temperatures for the month, the industry group said.
Sales of gifts by corporate customers were also slow, it said.
